milestones.claim: Scope stays limited to reviewer read evidence and does not make memory/playbook output gate evidence or alter scan escalation semantics.
milestones.doneMeans: Scope boundary, plan, and tests show only readManifest, read-log, mismatch reporting, template, token/read count, non-reviewer read safety, and smoke changes.

milestones.claim: scope_check_save requires a signed structured readManifest field.
milestones.doneMeans: Missing or malformed readManifest is rejected, valid readManifest is normalized and bound into the scope-check signature domain without weakening existing exclusions.

milestones.claim: review_pass_set requires the same signed structured readManifest field and exposes it for ledger comparison.
milestones.doneMeans: Missing or malformed readManifest is rejected for review passes, valid readManifest is signed with the review pass and can be inspected in stored evidence.

milestones.claim: Reviewer prompts and templates require submitters to provide readManifest.
milestones.doneMeans: Scope-plan and REVIEW-phase reviewer instructions contain the structured readManifest contract and missing submissions surface as gate rejections.

milestones.claim: Mechanical read-log evidence detects self-report mismatch, unrecorded full decisions-doc scans, and records read counts/token usage semantics.
milestones.doneMeans: Reviewer run evidence can include a digest-bound mechanical read log for decisions/*.md reads, explicit readCount/tokenCount semantics, and mismatch/unrecorded-full-scan cases are flagged without blocking legitimate escalation.

milestones.claim: Regression smoke coverage protects the readManifest gate, mismatch detector, JSON cleanliness, role separation, and non-reviewer Read safety.
milestones.doneMeans: reviewer-scan-budget-guard-smoke and validate wiring fail if missing readManifest passes, mismatches are not flagged, JSON output is polluted, reviewer evidence bypasses role separation, or non-reviewer reads are captured as reviewer evidence.
